name: codex-account-switcher
description: Save multiple Codex (ChatGPT) logins and switch between them without logging in again.

commands.title: Add Account (log in with another account)

codexAccounts.codexHome.description: Folder containing Codex's auth.json. Leave empty to use $CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

codexAccounts.loginCommand.description: Command run in a terminal by 'Add Account'.

codexAccounts.usageRefreshMinutes.description: How often to poll usage for all saved accounts (minutes). Applies after reload.

codexAccounts.warnThreshold.description: Highlight the status bar and suggest switching when any usage window reaches this percent. 0 disables.

codexAccounts.reloadAfterSwitch.description: Offer to reload the window after switching so the Codex extension picks up the new login.
